blocks.text: Reactants aur products ki physical states (thos, liquid, gas) ke lihaz se chemical equilibrium ki do qismein hain: homogeneous aur heterogeneous. Agla topic dono ki misalein deta hai.

blocks.prompt: 2NO₂(g) ⇌ N₂O₄(g) aur Fe₃O₄(s) + 4H₂(g) ⇌ 3Fe(s) + 4H₂O(g) mein se kaun homogeneous aur kaun heterogeneous hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehla homogeneous hai, kyun ke sab gases hain (ek hi phase). Doosra heterogeneous hai, kyun ke is mein solids aur gases dono hain.

items: Physical state ke lihaz se do qismein: homogeneous (ek phase) aur heterogeneous (ek se zyada phases).
